description: Owned by the strategy manager. First run: research plan, decision brief, signposts and deck for the CEO. Then monthly: checks the signposts and sends a short note or a reviewed update.

agentNode.instruction:
Agent folder ID {{EXE_B_FOLDER_ID}}. Today's date is today in Asia/Bangkok (not UTC).
0. The message that started this run: if it is empty or starts with "[scheduled run]", this is a scheduled run (a manual start may add words after the marker). Otherwise Khun Ton typed it: it is a request.
1. Open the "Agent setup" doc in the agent folder: the project folders to watch (links or IDs, one per line), the CEO's name and email, the strategy manager's email, language.
2. For EACH listed project folder read its sheet "Decision history" if it exists: goal (on the "first-brief" row), has_brief = a "first-brief" row exists, checked_this_month = a "monthly check" row exists this calendar month.
3. A request: do_first = true. goal = the decision question in Khun Ton's words. Find its project folder: a folder link in the request, else a subfolder of the agent folder whose name matches the request's topic, else none (new_folder = true, and project_name = a short name for the decision, e.g. "EV Charging Decision"). If that project already has a brief, do_first = false and say so in projects_status.
   A scheduled run: `projects` = every listed project that has_brief and is not checked_this_month (a re-run the same month skips the ones done). do_check = projects is not empty.
   Otherwise both are false.
4. For each project in `projects` return: folder ID, name, goal, CEO name and email (from Agent setup), the "Signposts" sheet ID, the latest brief URL, the "Board deck" ID, the "Decision history" file ID. month_id = "check-<YYYY-MM>".
   For a request, return for its project: folder ID (blank if new_folder) and name, listed = it is already listed in Agent setup, the internal documents in it (not files this agent made) as file IDs comma separated with last-modified dates, the "Decision history" file ID (blank if none), check_id ("first-brief" or "check-<YYYY-MM>"), the latest brief URL, the "Signposts" sheet ID, the "Board deck" ID.
5. `projects_status`: one line per project: name, and whether this month's check is done, plus this run's request if any.
Read only. Never guess. Return data only: never fail, never ask the user anything, never wait. If a tool is missing or fails, or a required file or doc is not found, still finish: return ready=false and in stop_reason say plainly what is missing and how to fix it (for example "Google Drive is not connected: connect the Drive tools in Gemini Enterprise, then run again"). Otherwise ready=true.

Write a short, plain message for the user in English. Use no tools. It is the last message of this run: do not ask the user a question and do not wait for an answer.
Say: "Stopped before doing anything: ${read_state.stop_reason} Nothing was produced or sent." Whoever reads this must not write the deliverable themselves.

nodes.displayName: What does this run need to do?

agentNode.instruction:
Write a short, plain message for the user in English. Use no tools. It is the last message of this run: do not ask the user a question and do not wait for an answer.
Say: "Nothing to do this run." then why, from ${read_state.projects_status}. If no project has a brief yet: "To start a decision brief, open this agent and type your decision question." Never write a brief or any other deliverable yourself.

nodes.displayName: Set up the project folder (only if new)

agentNode.instruction:
New decision: "${read_state.goal}" (project "${read_state.project_name}").
If ${read_state.new_folder} is false and ${read_state.listed} is true: write nothing; return project_folder_id = ${read_state.project_folder_id}.
Otherwise: 1. if ${read_state.new_folder} is true, create the folder "${read_state.project_name}" inside the agent folder {{EXE_B_FOLDER_ID}} with create_file_if_absent (mimeType application/vnd.google-apps.folder); 2. if ${read_state.listed} is false, add one line with the project folder's link to the "Agent setup" doc in {{EXE_B_FOLDER_ID}} (append_to_doc, once).
Return the project folder ID. Do nothing else. Search the folder for the exact title first; use create_file_if_absent so a second run never makes a second copy. Never retry a write that was confirmed. When the user answers 'Action Confirmed' or 'Review completed' the action HAS been done: never ask again, never repeat it.

Decision question: ${read_state.goal}. Internal documents (open by ID): ${read_state.internal_ids}, last modified ${read_state.internal_dates}.
Propose a research plan of 5 to 7 numbered sub-questions covering: market size and growth in the area, licensing and pricing rules, competitors (networks, locations, prices), likely returns by site type, main risks.
In `background` give at most 150 words on what the internal documents already say, and say which of them is older than 3 months and therefore probably out of date.
Return the sub-questions in `questions`, and `plan_card`: plain text, one sub-question per line numbered 1) 2) ..., a blank line, then 'Background:' and the summary. No brackets or quotes. Read only. Never guess.

Approved sub-questions: ${plan.questions}. The owner's feedback when approving: "${gate_plan.approval_feedback}".
If the feedback contains extra sub-questions, add each as a clear question (keep the originals). Otherwise return the originals unchanged. No tools.

Sub-question: ${research_loop_start.q}. Overall decision: ${read_state.goal}. Internal documents (open by ID): ${read_state.internal_ids}.
Use Google Search for this one sub-question only: regulators, official statistics, competitor announcements, reputable news. Combine with what the internal documents say.
Return a focused answer (up to about 300 words): key facts with numbers, each with its source (publisher, title, date and URL). Say where sources disagree, and where the internal documents are now out of date. Never invent facts.

Decision: ${read_state.goal}. Findings: ${research_loop.output[*].research.findings}.
Write the decision brief (Markdown): the realistic options (for example enter now, enter through a partnership, wait and prepare) with the evidence for and against each, the main risks, where sources disagree, and a recommendation.
Then 4 to 6 signposts: specific, measurable things that would change the recommendation (signpost, metric, threshold, current value, where to check). Return them also as CSV (header signpost,metric,threshold,current_value,source,last_checked).
`review_card`: the recommendation in two sentences, then the signposts one per line. Never invent facts. No tools.

In the project folder ${setup_project.project_folder_id} create the Google Doc "Decision brief draft (${read_state.today})" from Markdown ${draft.brief_md}, followed by a section "Signposts" with the signposts from ${draft.signposts_csv} as a table. Use create_file_if_absent. Return its ID and URL. Search the folder for the exact title first; use create_file_if_absent so a second run never makes a second copy. Never retry a write that was confirmed. When the user answers 'Action Confirmed' or 'Review completed' the action HAS been done: never ask again, never repeat it.

Open the draft doc ${save_draft.draft_id}: the owner may have edited it, and his edits win over the original text. Also apply the adjustments he typed: "${gate_brief.approval_feedback}" (also to the signposts).
Produce: `one_pager` (Markdown, one page: question, recommendation, options with evidence, risks, signposts), `deck_outline` (exactly 6 slides as Markdown: '# slide title' then 3 to 5 bullets each), the final `signposts_csv` (header signpost,metric,threshold,current_value,source,last_checked) with last_checked = ${read_state.today}, and `recommendation` in one sentence. Never invent facts. Read only.

In the project folder ${setup_project.project_folder_id} create exactly four files with create_file_if_absent, nothing else:
1. Google Doc "Decision brief v1 (${read_state.today})" from Markdown ${finalize.one_pager} (text/markdown).
2. Google Sheet "Signposts" from ${finalize.signposts_csv} (text/csv).
3. Google Slides "Board deck" from the outline ${finalize.deck_outline} (create_presentation_from_outline, 6 slides), in the same folder. If that tool fails, do not make an empty or placeholder presentation by any other means: leave deck_url blank.
4. Google Sheet "Decision history" (text/csv) with the header check_id,date,kind,stage,goal,signposts_triggered,recommendation,recommendation_changed,brief_url,deck_url,notes and one row: check_id="first-brief", date=${read_state.today}, kind="first brief", stage="sent", goal=${read_state.goal}, recommendation=${finalize.recommendation}, brief_url and deck_url (of files 1 and 3; if a URL is not known yet, leave it blank), notes="owner approved: ${gate_brief.approval_feedback}".
Return each file's ID and URL. Search the folder for the exact title first; use create_file_if_absent so a second run never makes a second copy. Never retry a write that was confirmed. When the user answers 'Action Confirmed' or 'Review completed' the action HAS been done: never ask again, never repeat it.

Send one email to ${read_state.ceo_email} (${read_state.ceo_name}). Subject: "Decision brief: ${read_state.goal}".
Say in two or three sentences what the recommendation is (${finalize.recommendation}) and that the strategy manager has reviewed it. Links: brief ${save_first.brief_url}, board deck ${save_first.deck_url} (if this link is blank, say plainly that the deck could not be made this time and will follow), signposts ${save_first.signposts_url}.
Explain that from now on the signposts are checked on the 1st of every month, and she will get a three-line note when nothing material has changed, or an updated brief when something has. She does not need to reply.
Write like a thoughtful colleague: warm, plain sentences, no headings, no robotic phrases. You are the decision-brief assistant working for the strategy manager; say so once. Write in English unless the Setup doc says Thai.
Search the folder for the exact title first; use create_file_if_absent so a second run never makes a second copy. Never retry a write that was confirmed. When the user answers 'Action Confirmed' or 'Review completed' the action HAS been done: never ask again, never repeat it.

Write a short, plain message for the user in English. Use no tools. It is the last message of this run: do not ask the user a question and do not wait for an answer.
Say: one line saying the first decision brief for "${read_state.project_name}" was sent to ${read_state.ceo_name}, and the next check is on the 1st of next month; then ${read_state.projects_status}. Then list the links: brief ${save_first.brief_url}, deck ${save_first.deck_url}, signposts ${save_first.signposts_url}, one per line.

Project "${check_loop_start.p.name}": ${check_loop_start.p.goal}. Open its sheet ${check_loop_start.p.signposts_id} (signposts) and its latest brief ${check_loop_start.p.latest_brief_url}.
For each signpost use Google Search for the latest figure or announcement: new registration figures, regulator decisions, competitor announcements, new incentives. Compare with its threshold and current_value.
Per signpost: triggered (true/false), new_value, evidence with source and date. material_change = true only if at least one is triggered. `summary`: two short lines on the overall trend.
If material_change: also write the updated one-page brief (Markdown) starting with "What changed": exactly what changed, which signpost was triggered, and whether the recommendation should change and why; keep the rest of the brief's structure. `replacements`: lines "old text => new text" for the deck slides that must change. Otherwise leave those blank.
Read only. Never invent data; a figure that could not be found is "not found" and that signpost is not triggered.

Projects: ${read_state.projects}. Results, in the same order: ${check_loop.output[*].check}.
Return `quiet`: the projects with no material change, each with its fields plus `summary`. Return `material`: the projects with a material change, each with its fields plus brief_md, replacements, recommendation, recommendation_changed, triggered. any_material = material is not empty. No tools.

Send exactly one email with Gmail (tool send_email, or send_message), then stop. To: ${quiet_loop_start.q.ceo_email}. Subject: Decision watch ${quiet_loop_start.q.name} ${read_state.month_id}: no material change. Body: Exactly three lines: "No material change this month." / one line on the trend from ${quiet_loop_start.q.summary} / "Next check: 1 <next month name>." Nothing else, no signature block..
Make one send call only. Answers like 'Action Confirmed' or 'Review completed' mean it was already sent: do not ask again and do not send again. Return sent=true.

In the project folder ${quiet_loop_start.q.folder_id}: in the sheet "Decision history" (${quiet_loop_start.q.history_id}), write ONE row with check_id = "${read_state.month_id}": if no row has that check_id add it with append_rows, otherwise update it with update_rows_by_key (key column check_id). Values: date=${read_state.today}, kind="monthly check", stage="no change", signposts_triggered="none", notes="${quiet_loop_start.q.summary}". Do not read or change any other file.

Write a short, plain message for the user in English. Use no tools. It is the last message of this run: do not ask the user a question and do not wait for an answer.
Say: monthly check ${read_state.month_id} done; no material change in ${collect.quiet}; a three-line note went to each CEO.

nodes.displayName: For each changed project: save draft
For each changed project: save draft
Save the updated brief for review

agentNode.instruction: In the project folder ${draft_loop_start.d.folder_id} create the Google Doc "Decision brief ${read_state.month_id}" from Markdown ${draft_loop_start.d.brief_md} with create_file_if_absent. Earlier versions stay as they are (decision history). Return the project name, the doc ID and URL. Search the folder for the exact title first; use create_file_if_absent so a second run never makes a second copy. Never retry a write that was confirmed. When the user answers 'Action Confirmed' or 'Review completed' the action HAS been done: never ask again, never repeat it.

Changed projects: ${collect.material}. Saved drafts: ${draft_loop.output[*].save_update_draft}.
Write `card`: per project, its name, which signpost was triggered, what changed and the new recommendation (at most 4 lines), and the draft link. No tools.

nodes.displayName: Review the updates before they reach the CEO
For each changed project: record held
For each changed project: record held

agentNode.instruction: In the project folder ${held_loop_start.h.folder_id}: in the sheet "Decision history" (${held_loop_start.h.history_id}), write ONE row with check_id = "${read_state.month_id}": if no row has that check_id add it with append_rows, otherwise update it with update_rows_by_key (key column check_id). Values: date=${read_state.today}, kind="monthly check", stage="held by owner", signposts_triggered="${held_loop_start.h.triggered}", notes="${gate_update.approval_feedback}". Do not read or change any other file.

nodes.displayName: For each changed project: finish and send
For each changed project: finish and send
Finish this project's brief and deck

agentNode.instruction:
Project "${send_loop_start.u.name}". The owner's typed adjustments for all projects: "${gate_update.approval_feedback}"; apply only those about this project.
1. Find the doc "Decision brief ${read_state.month_id}" in the project folder ${send_loop_start.u.folder_id}. If there are adjustments for this project, apply them (replace_text or replace_section; his own edits in the doc stay). If none, change nothing.
2. If the deck ${send_loop_start.u.deck_id} exists: copy_file it to "Board deck ${read_state.month_id}" in the same folder (skip if that title exists), then call replace_text_in_presentation ONCE on the copy with the replacements: ${send_loop_start.u.replacements}, so the deck says what the brief now says.
3. Update the sheet ${send_loop_start.u.signposts_id} with update_rows_by_key (key column signpost; these rows exist): current_value and last_checked=${read_state.today} from this project's check.
Return the brief and deck URLs. Search the folder for the exact title first; use create_file_if_absent so a second run never makes a second copy. Never retry a write that was confirmed. When the user answers 'Action Confirmed' or 'Review completed' the action HAS been done: never ask again, never repeat it.

Send exactly one email with Gmail (tool send_email, or send_message), then stop. To: ${send_loop_start.u.ceo_email}. Subject: Decision watch ${send_loop_start.u.name} ${read_state.month_id}: material change. Body: Three or four warm, plain sentences to ${send_loop_start.u.ceo_name}: which signpost was triggered (${send_loop_start.u.triggered}), what changed, whether the recommendation changes (${send_loop_start.u.recommendation}), and that the strategy manager has reviewed it. Links: updated brief ${save_update.brief_url}, deck ${save_update.deck_url}. Earlier versions are kept in the same folder..
Make one send call only. Answers like 'Action Confirmed' or 'Review completed' mean it was already sent: do not ask again and do not send again. Return sent=true.

In the project folder ${send_loop_start.u.folder_id}: in the sheet "Decision history" (${send_loop_start.u.history_id}), write ONE row with check_id = "${read_state.month_id}": if no row has that check_id add it with append_rows, otherwise update it with update_rows_by_key (key column check_id). Values: date=${read_state.today}, kind="monthly check", stage="sent", signposts_triggered="${send_loop_start.u.triggered}", recommendation="${send_loop_start.u.recommendation}", recommendation_changed="${send_loop_start.u.recommendation_changed}", brief_url="${save_update.brief_url}", deck_url="${save_update.deck_url}", notes="owner: ${gate_update.approval_feedback}". Do not read or change any other file.

Write a short, plain message for the user in English. Use no tools. It is the last message of this run: do not ask the user a question and do not wait for an answer.
Say: monthly check ${read_state.month_id} done. Updates sent: ${collect.material} (links ${send_loop.output[*].save_update}); no material change: ${collect.quiet}. Next check: the 1st of next month.

Write a short, plain message for the user in English. Use no tools. It is the last message of this run: do not ask the user a question and do not wait for an answer.
Say that the research plan for "${read_state.goal}" was rejected (${gate_plan.approval_feedback}), so nothing was researched, saved or sent. To get a new plan, start the agent again with the request reworded.

Write a short, plain message for the user in English. Use no tools. It is the last message of this run: do not ask the user a question and do not wait for an answer.
Say that the draft brief was not approved (${gate_brief.approval_feedback}). Nothing was sent to ${read_state.ceo_name}; the draft stays at ${save_draft.draft_url}. Start the agent again with the request to make a new one.
